name: media-tamer
description: Media Tamer — Firefox browser extension for video playback control (volume boost, speed, night mode, seek undo, media-roller download).

scripts.test:browser: node --test test/browser/extension.test.js test/browser/night-mode.test.js test/browser/popup-layout.test.js test/browser/popup-status-cleanup.test.js test/browser/popup-corner-spacing.test.js test/browser/popup-drag.test.js test/browser/popup-startup.test.js test/browser/block-number-toggle.test.js
scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:ext
scripts.format:check: prettier --check extensions/media-tamer/*.js test/unit/*.js test/browser/*.js scripts/*.mjs eslint.config.mjs .prettierrc.json
scripts.format: prettier --write extensions/media-tamer/*.js test/unit/*.js test/browser/*.js scripts/*.mjs eslint.config.mjs .prettierrc.json
